data.name: ViveTool_PageDescription
data.value: Whakahaere ngā wāhi whakatau o Windows i roto i te ViVeTool. Whakamahia, whakahohe, mō ngā whakaaturanga e arotake ana ki Windows.

data.name: ViveTool_WarningMessage
data.value: Hāpū nui: ka taea te pēke i Windows Update, ngā app, ngā kaiwhakaaro (drivers), ā, te wāhi tūtonu o te sistema e whakaputa ana i te whakakere i ngā wāhi whakatau o Windows. Whakarite atu ki te rorohiko hou kia tīmata. Whakatō anake i ngā Feature ID kua whakamowehore. Ka hiahiatia te pūmau mo ētahi whakahau ā, me kore e whakaorangia he kaimoana.

data.name: ViveTool_ViveToolNotFound
data.value: Kāore i hāia te ViVeTool. Whakarite atu kia whakautu, whakatō, me ngā wāhi o tāngata e pūmanawa (runtime) o te ViVeTool kua wehe hononga.
